description:
Hello, let’s meet!

 

 

Xebia is a global AI-first, digital transformation, and engineering partner. With over 25 years of experience and a team of 5,000 professionals across 16 countries, we help organizations design and build scalable products, platforms, and data-driven solutions. 

We specialize in Artificial Intelligence, Data and Cloud, Intelligent Automation, and Digital Products, combining deep technical expertise with a strong focus on engineering excellence and a people-first culture.  

In the CEE region, we’re a team of nearly 1,000 experts delivering modern applications, data platforms, and AI solutions for clients such as Millennium, ING, Play, Edenred, Arabian Drilling, FedEx, Leroy Merlin, Truecaller, Volotea, Schmitz Cargobull, and many, many more.

 

 

You will be:

 

  • supporting development teams with product knowledge, technical guidance, and solution design,
  • maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines and build environments,
  • managing and improving infrastructure automation and configuration processes,
  • troubleshooting technical issues and providing guidance on improvements and best practices,
  • supporting infrastructure across both cloud and on-premises air-gapped environments,
  • contributing to the planning and implementation of new features and technical improvements,
  • supporting monitoring and observability initiatives,
  • collaborating with development and infrastructure teams to ensure reliable and efficient delivery.

 

Your profile:

  • hands-on experience as an AWS DevOps Engineer or in a similar role,
  • practical experience using AI-powered assistants (e.g. Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to improve productivity, quality, or decision-making in software delivery,
  • practical experience with Ansible, Terraform, Bash, Git, and CI/CD pipelines,
  • experience with Docker and Docker Swarm,
  • good knowledge of core AWS services, including EC2, CloudFormation, VPC, Subnets, AMIs, ALBs, S3, and ECR,
  • understand Infrastructure as Code, configuration management, and cloud infrastructure principles,
  • experience working with both cloud and on-premises, air-gapped environments,
  • a good understanding of JSON,
  • familiarity with monitoring and observability solutions and have an appreciation of ELK Stack and Grafana,
  • experience with firewall management, preferably FortiGate,
  • understand Agile development processes and have a strong DevOps mindset,
  • good troubleshooting and problem-solving skills,
  • can provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively with development and infrastructure teams,
  • proactive and comfortable contributing to technical planning and continuous improvement,
  • good English communication skills (at least B2 level).

 

 

 

Work from the European Union region and a work permit are required.

 

 

Recruitment Process:

CV review – HR call – Interview – Client Interview – Decision
